messages:
Sam (sales): Heads-up — Prospect AltWave asked for SOC2 artifacts + a signed pen-test letter for the POC starting Monday. Need timeline and who can sign. Also asked for staging IP CIDR for their firewall and confirmation on KMS separation.
Priya (solutions): cc @Aiden — do we have a short pen-test attestation we can sign for POCs? If not, can we provide a letter of intent plus a redacted scan?
Aiden (security): We have a standard pen-test attestation template (vendor name/date/scope). For POC customers we usually provide a limited attestation + redacted vulnerability scan. Full pen-test reports get redacted before sharing. Legal needs to sign the attestation.
Elena (legal): We can sign the standard attestation. If AltWave sends their own template, we need to review for any warranty/indemnity clauses. Also we must redact any sensitive vuln details. Are they asking for network diagrams?
Sam (sales): They want staging IPs to open on their side and confirmation somebody will sign the attestation. Also want to know cost impact if we have to spin dedicated capacity for isolation — they're asking for a number.
Marta (infra): Staging pool IPs available right now: `18.203.45.0/28` and `18.203.45.16/28` (ephemeral). If they need stable, reserved IPs it needs a small ops task (24-48h) and could push the window. Dedicated/reserved tenant isolation impacts billing — might require a short-term reserved pool.
Priya (solutions): Ballpark: Dedicated reserved pool + isolation for POC = ~+25% on top of committed price for the month, or a short-term burst at higher per-hour. If they insist on BYOK and EU residency that's a Private deployment conversation.
Sam (sales): OK. Can Aiden/Elena get the attestation ready by EOD? I will send AltWave's checklist and their pen-test template into the thread.
Aiden (security): I can draft the limited attestation. Need confirmation on KMS: POC uses Redwood-managed KMS by default. If customer requests BYOK that's only supported on Private or Dedicated with KMS integration — requires procurement.
Marta (infra): Confirmed: POC = Redwood-managed KMS, keys non-exportable, tenant separation enforced at process level. I'll create a short KMS separation note and an architecture excerpt. If customer needs BYOK, that is a different engagement.
Elena (legal): Please ensure the draft attestation contains no acceptance of vulnerability liability. We can sign a statement of fact (we maintain recent third-party pen test, here's redacted scan) but not custom liability or indemnities.
Sam (sales): I'll ask AltWave whether they accept a redacted scan + attestation. I'll also flag pricing impact if they want Dedicated.
devops-bot: deploy:staging-pool created — `18.203.45.0/28`, `18.203.45.16/28` — ephemeral window 72h.
Priya (solutions): Next steps: 1) Aiden -> draft attestation 2) Elena -> review/sign 3) Marta -> formalize IPs + KMS statement 4) Sam -> confirm AltWave accepts redacted scan + attestation. Target EOD.
Aiden (security): On it. Draft by 16:30 PT.
Elena (legal): I'll review by 17:30 PT, unless AltWave's template requires heavier negotiation.
Marta (infra): I'll request stable IP allocation and post the architecture excerpt by EOD.
Sam (sales): Thanks all :thumbsup: — I'll update AltWave once we have the draft. If they insist on Dedicated for POC, ping me immediately so I can surface budget.
Priya (solutions): FYI — if they require EU residency + BYOK + dedicated tenancy, we should convert this POC scope call into a Private deployment RFP. Flagging for next call.
Sam (sales): Noted. Closing loop later tonight.
